card.name: Table footnote marker letter a
card.fires_on: The letter "a" used as a footnote marker at the end of a table row, title or abbreviation list, just before the footnote text starts.

modes.label: Footnote after dosing row
modes.description: Marker "a" after a dosing schedule or dose line in a table, introducing a note on calculation or conversion.
modes.example: intravenously Every 48 hours<< a>> As calculated using the Cockcroft-Gault

modes.label: Footnote after abbreviation key
modes.description: Marker "a" after a list of abbreviations or definitions below a table, introducing a source or cross-reference.
modes.example: ESA = Erythropoiesis stimulating agent.<< a>> See dosing modifications in Section 2

card.writes: It promotes footnote openers such as "See" and "Some", pointing to a cross-reference note.
card.plain: It spots the little letter a that marks a table footnote, right before the note text begins.
